༄༅/ /dpal ri padma 'od du bgrod pa'i smon lam gdung shugs kyi glog 'phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ri padma 'od du bgrod pa'i smon lam gdung shugs kyi glog 'phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las ma lus pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ brtan g.yo thams cad kyi khyab bdag dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'char gzhi/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rje chos kyi rgyal po ma hā gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol// rang byung lhun 'grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// mya ngan mi 'da' 'jigs bral rdo rje'i sku// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs mchog /he ru ka dpal padma badzra zhes// mtsho skyes dbang gi rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku spros pa mkha' ltar dag gyur kyang*// longs sku 'gag med thugs rje'i sprin phung las// sprul skus gdul bya'i 'jig rten ma lus par// sna tshogs theg pa'i chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i// sku gsum lhun gyis grub der phyag 'tshal lo// khyod gsung dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor re res kyang*// srid gsum 'gro ba ma lus rang rang gi /skad du brgyad khri bzhi stong dam pa'i chos// ston pas rnam grol 'bras bu ster mdzad pa// skyon bral padma'i gsung la= mkhyen pas skad cig nyid la 'khor 'das kyi// chos rnams ma lugs thugs su mkhyen gyur cing*// rtog pa med par 'gro don lhun gyis grub// nam mkha'i rang bzhin gzod nas rnam grol thugs// ye shes bsam mi khyab der phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni 'jig rten sgron ma padma'i gnyen// kun gyis mi brdzi 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gcig /mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i skye ldan yang*// mod la thar pa'i dga' ston la sbyor ba'i// yon tan 'gran zla bral der=

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams mthas gtugs par// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyis// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pas// ma lus gdul bya'i re ba rdzogs mdzad pa'i// 'phrin las srid mthar khyab der= skye bo dge ba'i bshes dang bral gyur zhing*// mi shes mun pa'i smag rum 'khyams pa rnams// de ring nyid du thugs rje'i zer phyungs la// ma rig 'thibs po sol cig padma 'byung*// bdag gis bgrang yas skye bar tshogs gnyis kyis// legs bsdus rnam par dkar ba dge ba'i tshogs// ma lus lus pa med pa'i 'gro kun dang*// thun mong nyid gyur gong du spel ba'i mthus// thams cad zangs mdog dpal rir skye bar shog /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing gi bkod pa kun// yongs su rdzogs pa rnga yab padma'i gnyen// lag mthil ltar snyoms rgya khyon tshad kyis 'phongs// rin chen nor bu'i khor yug kun nas dkris// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /mtha' grur mtshan mo rgyu ba'i grong khyer dang*// grong rdal bgrang dang gzhal bar mi nus pa'i// mi bsrun mi la 'tshe ba'i yul ljongs kun// dge bcu'i khrims las skad cig mi 'da' ba'i// zangs mdog= zhe sdang gdong dmar srin po'i tshogs rnams kyang*// khyod mthus mi dge 'gras pa'i yid bral nas// byang chub sems kyi ngang tshul rab 'chang zhing*// mi khom sha zar skye ba'i tha ma ste// zangs mdog= 'dzin ma'i khyon kun bde 'jam mig mang ris// mnan nem btegs 'phar gser gyi padmo dang*// lha gnas nor bus phyogs kun mdzes par bkram// tsher can shing dang gseg ma ri med pa// zangs mdog= kai la sha dang baiḍūr ind+ra sogs// rin chen ri phran dpag bsam yongs 'du'i tshal// 'chi med shing gis gtams pa'i rtse mo kun// dbang po'i shing bal mdangs ldan me tog mdzes// zangs mdog= yid bzhin nor bu'i 'bras bus g.yur za shing*// yal gar lha rdzas gos kyi lda ldi dang*// mu tig dkar dmar sngo ba'i 'phyang phrul g.yo// spu sdug sprul pa'i bya tshogs skad snyan 'byin// zangs mdog=

bar bar yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i rdzing*// mthil du gser gyi bye ma thang mar rdal// phyogs rnams rin chen sna bdun them skas can// sprul pa'i lha mi mang po dal gyis rtse// zangs mdog= 'gram kun yid 'ong sgyu 'phrul chu bya'i tshogs// 'dab ma'i gar sgyur mgo bo kyog nas blta// byu ru ltar dmar sor mos chu thigs 'thor// mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung la ngal ba med// zangs mdog= spos chu'i dri bsung ldan pa nam mkha'i dbugs// nan ltar tsha dang bsil ches ma yin zhing*// ldang dang zhi la 'dod pa'i dbang 'byor pa// dal gyis btab pas rdzing bu padmas khebs/ zangs mdog= ljongs kun rin chen sna bdun gzhal med khang*// nang du ratna'i khri la dar zab dang*// lha rdzas snying po can gyi mal stan ni// 'chi med grong gi dga' ba 'phrog byed pa// zangs mdog= phyir mi ldog pa'i lha mis kun nas gang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam pa'i mod la 'byung*// bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal gzis phan tshun du// ltad mo'i dam pa mtho ris do rar rtse// zangs mdog= chags na lta dang gnyis med 'khyud pa yis// 'jig rten 'dod yon kun gyi dpal thob cing*// zag med bsam gtan gnyis pa'i bde la gzhol// tha mal chags pa'i dri ma ring du bral// zangs mdog= rab dkar bdud rtsi'i chu gter 'o ma'i mtsho'i// dpal gyi 'dab ma'i 'od kyis bar snang 'khengs// sgyu 'phrul mdangs mdzes ge sar 'dzin pa'i tshogs// mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs 'bod grogs ci yang 'byin// zangs mdog= bar snang bdud rtsi'i chu mig las 'ongs pa'i// sprin bcud lha yi me tog 'khor lo'i char// sman shing gur kum gzhon nu chu skyes dang*// 'ja' zer myu gu'i mdangs la bsil bar 'grems// zangs mdog= dbus su padma rā ga'i lhun po ni// rtsa ba gtsug na nor bu'i gzhal med khang*// sked par rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i mchod sdong mdzes// rtse mor bar snang lha rnams skor ba byed// zangs mdog=

phyogs bzhir mi shigs rin chen rdo rje'i zam// gser dngul baiḍūrya yi stegs bu la// sgyu 'phrul zhi dang khro chags rakṣa dang*// lha klu mi yi dbang po kun nas rgyu// zangs mdog= phyogs bzhir gser dngul baiḍūrya dang ni/ ind+ra'i them skas rdzu 'phrul 'od kyi lam// rgyu byed 'dor ba'i mod la dpal ri'i rtser// glog 'gyu'i yud la bgrod pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul// zangs mdog= rtse mor padma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang*// dag pa'i rdo dkar bai ḍūrya dang ni// padma rā ga ind+ra nī la yi// glo 'bur 'phrin las bzhi yi rang 'od 'bar// zangs mdog= phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bar dang khyams// gru chad sgo khang rta babs chos 'khor rgyan// rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dang*// drwa phyed mda' yab rin chen bdun gyis spras// zangs mdog= rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// byang chub yan lag 'phan gyis kun nas mdzes// zur rnams gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha la// spos chu'i rlung bskyod chos kyi sgra dbyangs sil// zangs mdog= logs la mngon shes drug ldan skar khung gsal// steng du gser gdugs nor bu'i bla bre can// dbus kyi 'phyur bu rdo rje rin po che'i// tog gi 'od zer nyin mor byed la 'khu// zangs mdog= kun kyang rang byung lhun grub snang ba'i 'phrul// reg na mi thogs phyi nang med par gsal// steng nas lha yi mchod sprin char du 'bebs// bar snang 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i sprin phung 'khrigs/ zangs mdog= de dbus rin chen zur brgyad nyi zla dang*// ma chags padma stong gi ge sar la// sgyu 'phrul bdag po padma 'byung gnas ni// mdzes sdug brjid chags gser gyi lhun po 'dra// zangs mdog= nyi zla gza' skar snang byed thams cad kyang*// khyod sku'i 'od kyis zil gnon rtag par yang*// gur kum mtshal gyis dkrigs 'dra'i mdzes pa 'dzin// nyin mtshan 'od gsal khor mor 'byams brdal ba// zangs mdog=

mtha' skor dus gsum bla ma sprin ltar gtibs// phyogs mtshams sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad bde gshegs lnga// sgrub pa bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lngas dang*// theg pa rim dgu'i lha tshogs tshom bur g.yo// zangs mdog= phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab rigs bzhi'i ging dang ni// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// rang 'dra bye ba 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// 'gying bag phyed skyil rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs// zangs mdog= khyams dang gru chad glo 'bur rig 'dzin dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro lha dang lha mo'i tshogs// dpag tu med pa lang tsho'i dpal ngoms shing*// phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pas mchod// zangs mdog= 'dod snam mchod pa'i lha mo dpag yas pa// 'dod yon drug dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// srid zhi'i mtshar du dngar ba ma lus pas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgyes pa skyed mdzad ma// zangs mdog= sgo mtshams phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen bzhi// bka' nyan gtum po lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs// bdud dang mu stegs bstan dgra mthar byed cing*// theg mchog rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor byed/ zangs mdog= gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'dun sar lan re res// dpag med 'gro bas sa mchog dngos grub thob// lhun grub phyag rgya che dang tshe la dbang*// rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sa la 'jog /zangs mdog= zhing de'i yon tan mtha' dag bskal pa'am// de las lhag par dus gsum rgyal ba yis// ma bzlos bsngags kyang zad par mi nus shing*// skad cig dran pas bde chen mchog thob pa'i// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /lha yi lhar gyur rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// o rgyan padma rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas// mgon med bu la brtse bas ma ltar gzigs// thugs rje mchog gi lcags kyus rab brkyang nas// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor myur drongs shig /'gro ba'i spyi dang khyad par bod 'bangs la// rnam mkhyen gzhan pas thugs rje'i zer myur bar// brtse bas zhal gyis 'ches te rjes dgongs la// ma rungs las kyis mnar ba'i snyigs dus 'gro// la 'ur thugs rjes gzigs shig padma 'byung*// don ldan dge sbyor le lo'i chom pos 'khyer// log sgrub rnam g.yeng chu bo'i gnyer ma bzhin// 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'phral snang drag pos 'drid// ma tshor mi tshe 'dzad pa'i dred po la// 'dren pa gzhan na med do padma 'byung*// chos sgor zhugs kyang dge sbyor chos kyis dben// blo sems dred pos bsrung sdom gnad tshang stor// bag med spyod pas ngo tsha'i lcibs dang bral// ltung ba'i char gyis nyin mtshan gdungs pa la// bslab gsum gos kyis g.yogs shig padma 'byung*// lam mchog byang chub sems la blo sbyangs kyang*// gshis ngan rang rtsis rgyud la 'thas pa yis// dgra gnyen chags sdang mgo bo ma snyoms pas/

khro sdang bzod pa'i go dang bral ba tsho// smon 'jug srang du chug cig padma 'byung*// gsang sngags lam zhugs bskyed rdzogs par rlom yang*// rang rgyud dngos por sgom la a 'thas shing*// gnyid chang rmongs pas zab mo'i bzlas pa chag /dam med rgyud la drod rtags mi ldan pas// snang srid lha skur ston cig padma 'byung*// zhi gnas bsam gtan don la mnyam bzhag kyang*// dran shes mi ldan lung ma bstan gyis rmongs// yang na bying rgod 'phro 'du'i rtog par 'chor// 'khu 'khrig 'jur bus bcings pa'i sgom pa la// rtse gcig ngo bo ston cig padma 'byung*// don dam lhag mthong nyams su myong 'dod kyang*// chos kun chos nyid tshad mar ma phyin pas// gnyis snang bzang ngan rtog pa bshig ma nus// zhe 'dod rtsol bas bslad pa'i sgom pa la// byed po'i blo dang phrol cig padma 'byung*// mdor na gnyis snang chu lbur chu la thim// nyams myong zhe 'dod nam mkhar sprin ltar yal// spang blang thob shor sbrul mdud rang sar grol// ye gdal gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa de// 'gro kun rgyud la sbyor cig padma 'byung*// de ltar gdung shugs drag po'i 'o dod la// g.yeng med thugs rjes myur du mi gzigs par// rang rang las kyi rnam smin yin dgongs na// las dang bral la thugs rjes gzigs kyang ci// khyed kyi thugs dam g.yel lam padma 'byung*// des na btang snyoms le lo ma mdzad par// ri dwags 'thums bral lta bu'i 'gro ba la// thugs rje'i gzigs pas bul min ches lhag pa// la 'ur thugs rjes mchog sbyin mdzod cig ces// gdung ba'i smre sngags thal lo padma 'byung*// zag bcas lus dang ma bral bar du yang*// gnas skabs tshe la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// 'phags pa'i ri ngogs dben cing nyams dga' bar// rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin 'grub gyur nas// nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar byin gyis rlobs// nyer len sgyu ma'i zol khang 'gyel ma thag

/rol mo'i sgra dang sngon 'jug mchod sprin gtibs// ngo mtshar 'ja' 'od gdung gi rtags dang bcas// o rgyan padma bzhugs pa'i zhabs drung der// padma'i sbubs su rdzus te skye bar shog /zhing der gdod ma'i chos sku mngon gyur nas// gzugs sku'i rol pas 'khor ba ma stongs bar// khyod kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel ba dang*// 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i byed po ru// dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod lung bstan thob par shog /'gro ba'i don la skyo bsun ngal dub dang*// sgyid lugs zhum khengs nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// dbang bcu mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams kyis// sdug bsngal srid pa'i mtsho chen ma bskams bar// gzugs sku'i nyin byed nub par ma gyur cig /bdag gi brtson pas ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro /mtha' gnyis srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas// zad cing stongs tshe bdag kyang khyod ji bzhin// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku thob ste// mnyam nyid rdo rje'i gral la 'god par shog /padma dkar pos mkhar chur sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig// /maṅgalaṃ/// /
